violation_type.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §744.2007(b)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily
violation_type.typical_finding: During an inspection, children were observed watching a movie and exceeding the one hour time limit.

finding_variants.text: During an inspection, children were observed watching a movie and exceeding the one hour time limit.

7 Children were observed playing and watching non-educational video games on chromebooks. Three children had access to chromebooks for more than one hour. Children were allowed to watch a movie after using chromebooks for more than one hour.
The program used screen time for over an hour..
A child was observed to be on their phone though out the length of the inspection. The child exceeded the one hour time limit, the cell phone use was not related to homework or an activity.
The children watched a movie during today's inspection that exceed the one hour screen time limit.
This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and was found to be deficient. Children have been exceeding an hour of screen time.
